title: ESO character build (phase 1: character sheet)
description: A fully specified level 50, CP160, gold quality build. Fixed assumptions are not fields: level 50, CP160 gear, gold quality, set ranges resolve to their maximum. Fields reserved for later phases carry a 'reserved' note and are accepted but must hold their default value.

classSkillLines.description: Subclassing (Update 46). The three class skill lines this character actually has. Defaults to the three lines of 'class'. Order does not matter.

classMastery.description: Class Mastery passives purchased (Update 50). Two Class Mastery Points exist, so at most two names. Only applies when classSkillLines are the native lines of 'class' (the game hides the line while subclassing).

attributes.$comment: Engine validation: health + magicka + stamina must equal 64.

enabled.description: true = every passive (non slottable) star at max rank plus the slotted stars below. false = no Champion Points at all (Battlegrounds, no-CP campaigns).

points.description: Stages bought in a star when fewer than its maximum, by star name (Sustaining Shadows has 50 one point stages). Missing means the maximum.

notTaken.description: Passive (non slottable) stars this character has not bought. Every other passive star is assumed at max rank. Example: ["Sprinter"].

food.description: Id of a food or drink from constants.json foods, null for no buff, or an explicit custom buff typed from the item tooltip.

vampireStage.description: 0 = not a vampire. 1 to 4 = vampire stage. Any stage above 0 unlocks the Vampire skill line for slotting and applies stage effects.

werewolf.description: Has Lycanthropy. Unlocks the Werewolf skill line for slotting.

werewolfForm.description: Compute the sheet while transformed. Werewolf passives that read 'WHILE IN WEREWOLF FORM' only apply when true.

activeBuffs.description: Named buffs up at the time of the reading (potion, a skill cast before the sheet was read): Major Brutality, Major Sorcery, Minor Resolve and so on. Applied through the named buff table, never stacking with the same buff from gear or passives.

scribing.description: Scripts chosen for slotted grimoires, keyed by grimoire name. Scripts act on cast and do not change the sheet in phase 1; they are kept so a build is complete for later phases.

skillLines.description: Skill lines the character has, beyond class, racial, armor and weapon lines which are always present. Missing keys default to true for Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, Psijic Order, Undaunted, Assault, Support and Soul Magic, and false for anything else (Legerdemain, Dark Brotherhood, Thieves Guild).

passives.description: Which passive skills are considered purchased at max rank. Default: every passive in every skill line the character has access to (class lines, racial, all armor and weapon lines, guilds, Alliance War, Vampire or Werewolf when unlocked).

exclude.description: Passive names to switch off when mode is 'all'.

include.description: Passive names to switch on when mode is 'none'.

bars.description: bars[0] is the front bar, bars[1] the back bar.

flags.description: Engine strategy switches used during validation against fixtures. Omit for defaults.

itemQuality.description: When true, each item's quality field is used; when false every item counts as gold.

nearKeep.description: Deprecated, read as cyrodiil.enabled and cyrodiil.nearKeep.

cyrodiil.description: Cyrodiil campaign state, applied only while Battle Spirit is on.

nearKeep.description: Combat Medic: 20% Healing Done near a Keep (fixtures 001 and 009).

continuousAttack.description: Within 10 minutes of capturing a resource or Keep: Continuous Attack's Weapon and Spell Damage and recovery bonus.

offensiveScrolls.description: Offensive Elder Scrolls the alliance holds (bonus I or II).

defensiveScrolls.description: Defensive Elder Scrolls the alliance holds (bonus I or II).

enemyKeeps.description: Enemy Keeps the alliance holds (crit 1% each).

allianceEmperorKeeps.description: Home Keeps held while the alliance has an Emperor (0 = no Emperor); Emperorship Alliance Bonus I to VI.

emperor.description: This character is the Emperor. The Emperor skill line values are not archived yet.

esoPlus.description: ESO Plus member: the sheet shows 10% Experience, Gold, Crafting Inspiration, Tel Var and Alliance Points.

battleSpiritFlatHealth.description: Add 1600 flat Max Health under Battle Spirit. Off: fixture 007 (Cyrodiil) reads exactly without it; fixtures 001 and 002 had suggested it.

strategies.description: Named order-of-operation strategies, see engine docs.

slottedStars.description: Names of slottable stars (the 'Active Perks' and 'Base Active Perks' rows of the Champion tables), each treated as max rank. At most 4 per constellation.

quality.description: Item quality. Read only when flags.itemQuality is true; otherwise every item is gold. Traits scale from the UESP trait tables, armor and weapon ratings by items.qualityFactor (unverified below gold).

weaponEnchant.description: All weapon glyphs are combat procs in phase 1 and do not change the sheet. Kept so the build is complete for later phases.

setRef.description: Set name exactly as the page title in sets.csv without the 'Online:' prefix and without a trailing ' (set)'. Perfected trial and arena sets are separate names ('Perfected Saxhleel Champion'). null = no set.

weaponSlot.description: A weapon or a shield. A shield is only valid in offHand, takes armor traits and armor enchants, has no weight and counts as one set piece.

offHand.$comment: Must be null when mainHand is a two handed weapon (greatsword, battle axe, maul, bow, any staff).

skills.description: Five positional slots (slot 1 to 5 are the buttons); null is an empty slot. Ability names are final nodes only: the morph name, or the base name if unmorphed. Only used for 'while slotted' effects.

poison.description: Poison applied to this bar's weapons. A poison overrides the weapon enchant while it has charges. Combat proc, no sheet effect in phase 1.
